sources.label: Official Castore size guide (Women's body measurements, cm)

audit: Same URL still live. Women's (Body Measurements), printed cm column (inches also printed, not stored); chest stored as bust. Sizes printed as XXS-6 ... 3XL-20. The numbers shift letters: old XS uk 6 80/62/86 now XS-8 84/66/91; old M uk 10 88/70/94 now M-12 94/76/101; old 2XL uk 16 100/82/106 now 2XL-18 109/91/116. Number after the letter isn't labelled UK on the guide, so uk field left out, as are US/EU. XXS-6 and 3XL-20 added.
